paragraphs: R. Naftali asked R. Mana and was a priest, Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Ta'anit 4 and Megillah 4, halakhah 8: his finger was crooked [reading from the cited Yerushalmi parallels]. R. Yaakov ben Naftali—I did not find his mention. There is also R. Yitzḥak bar Naftali.
